tasks.title: Learn Angular Components
tasks.description: Study component lifecycle hooks, data binding, and the difference between smart and dumb components. Practice creating reusable components.

tasks.title: Practice Reactive Forms
tasks.description: Build complex forms using FormGroup, FormControl, and Validators. Learn the difference between reactive and template-driven forms.

tasks.title: Study Angular Routing
tasks.description: Understand lazy loading, route guards, route parameters, and child routes. Implement navigation in a real project.

tasks.title: Explore RxJS Operators
tasks.description: Learn map, switchMap, mergeMap, catchError, tap, and other essential operators. Practice with real HTTP calls.

tasks.title: Build Custom Directives
tasks.description: Create attribute and structural directives. Understand how to manipulate the DOM safely with ElementRef and Renderer2.

tasks.title: Implement Authentication Flow
tasks.description: Build login/logout functionality with guards, interceptors, and token management. Understand the auth flow end-to-end.

tasks.title: Write Unit Tests
tasks.description: Learn Angular testing utilities: TestBed, ComponentFixture, and dependency injection in tests. Write tests for services and components.

tasks.title: Optimize Performance
tasks.description: Study change detection strategies (Default vs OnPush), trackBy in ngFor, and lazy loading. Profile the app with Angular DevTools.
